page.layout: One column of names, set as lines grouped by year, with the year in the left margin beside each group; a rule separates the groups. Two notes in the right margin: "Belli eiusce compositio" (upper right, partly cut off) and a longer small-type note lower right, "Decreto cautū, ne liceat Adoardiis emere prædia plura, aut reditus quàm habebant." Page number at the head.

main_text.l: Decreto cautū, ne liceat Adoardiis emere prædia plura, aut reditus quàm habebant.1342Otto Podar:

page.notes: The years 1336–1342 are printed in the left margin beside the groups of names. The right-margin note "Belli eiusce compositio" is cut off at the edge of the scan; "eiusce" and "compositio" are uncertain, with the letters of the second word hard to separate. "Hugtng" (1337) may be a misprint for "Huging". Names are copied as printed; the lower margin rule and a stray mark at the foot are not text.
